title: Nvidia Board Rejects Jensen Huang CEO Return in 2026
summary: Nvidia's board unanimously rejected Jensen Huang's offer to return as CEO following his resignation over conduct violations. Colette Kress serves as interim
body_markdown:
#### 💡 TL;DR


- Nvidia's board unanimously rejected Jensen Huang's offer to return as CEO during the November 17, 2026 earnings call.
- Huang resigned November 12 following revelations of extramarital affairs, including one with a woman accused of Chinese intelligence ties.
- Colette Kress serves as interim CEO while the board searches for both internal and external permanent replacement candidates.


Nvidia has officially closed the door on founder Jensen Huang's potential return to the CEO role. During the company's November 17, 2026 earnings call, board chairman Harvey C. Jones announced that the board unanimously rejected Huang's public offer to resume leadership of the AI chip giant, citing conduct violations that led to his November 12 resignation.


## Board's Definitive Statement


Jones delivered a clear message to investors and employees during Tuesday's earnings call. "On November 12, our board of directors announced that after disclosure of personal behavior inconsistent with the company's code of conduct, standards, and cultural norms, Jensen Huang voluntarily resigned his positions as president, CEO, and board member," Jones stated. "The Nvidia board unanimously accepted his resignation and does not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO."


The announcement came just hours after Huang posted on X that he had "seen an outpouring of calls from Nvidia's employees, investors, business partners, and customers" requesting his return. Huang had indicated he would be "honored to answer these calls and return as CEO" if the board determined it was in shareholders' best interests.


## Conduct Violations Behind Resignation


Huang's departure followed revelations of multiple extramarital affairs, including a relationship with former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, who has been accused of working for Chinese intelligence. U.S. intelligence officials have expressed concerns that she may be affiliated with China's Ministry of State Security, raising questions about potential influence over Nvidia's China dealings.


The[scandal has triggered multiple investigations](https://emergent.sh/news/jensen-huang-scandal-timeline-nvidia-ceo) , including an independent board inquiry into Huang's activities and an SEC probe into Nvidia. Reports have emerged of additional affairs, including one with an Nvidia executive, further complicating the situation. The revelations have sent shockwaves through the tech industry at a critical moment for AI infrastructure development.


## Leadership Transition Underway


Colette Kress, Nvidia's chief financial officer and executive vice president, is serving as interim CEO while the board conducts a comprehensive search for a permanent replacement. Officially launched on November 12, 2026, the transition occurred immediately following Huang's resignation announcement. Jones confirmed Tuesday that the search process is considering both internal and external candidates, signaling the board's openness to new leadership perspectives.


The timing presents significant challenges for Nvidia, which dominates the AI chip market and supplies critical hardware for training large language models and running inference workloads. Industry observers worry about potential disruption to customer relationships, product roadmaps, and strategic partnerships during this leadership vacuum.


## Industry Response and Investigations


The situation has drawn unprecedented attention from multiple stakeholders.[Tech executives including Elon Musk have signed petitions](https://emergent.sh/news/elon-musk-signs-petition-reinstate-nvidia-ceo) calling for Huang's reinstatement, while FBI reports indicate security concerns related to the intelligence allegations.[Huang has agreed to testify before Congress](https://emergent.sh/news/jensen-huang-agrees-testify-before-congress) as lawmakers examine the national security implications of the alleged Chinese intelligence connection.


Meanwhile, Nvidia's business operations continue under Kress's interim leadership. The company maintains its position as the dominant supplier of GPUs for AI training and inference, with major cloud providers and enterprises dependent on its hardware. Jones emphasized during the earnings call that the board remains focused on maintaining business continuity and protecting shareholder value throughout the transition period.


## What This Means


Nvidia's decisive rejection of Huang's return marks a turning point for one of the AI industry's most critical companies. The board's unwillingness to consider reinstatement, despite public pressure and Huang's legendary status as a founder, signals serious concerns about the conduct violations and their potential legal and security ramifications. As Nvidia searches for new permanent leadership, the AI industry faces uncertainty about the future direction of its most essential hardware provider. The outcome of ongoing investigations and the identity of Huang's successor will shape the trajectory of AI infrastructure development for years to come.
